ITEM 1 | Pale white/ivory cubes with smooth, slightly translucent surface, firm and matte-to-lightly-moist, about 2-3 cm pieces, uncooked-looking cut edges, five pieces clustered in the upper-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown roasted potato chunks with crisp, browned edges and irregular faces, some flecked with green herb bits and a light sheen, about 2-3 cm cubes, grouped in the upper-right area of the plate | 120
ITEM 3 | Halved and sectioned green Brussels sprouts with bright green outer leaves and pale yellow-green cut centers, showing charred or browned edges and a glossy, slightly oily sheen, piled in the center-left of the plate | 90
ITEM 4 | Wilted dark green leafy greens with crinkled, slightly glossy texture, scattered beneath and around the sprouts, some torn pieces about 3-5 cm | 35
ITEM 5 | Pale tan/beige piece with soft, moist, slightly browned surface, flat and irregular, partially under the sprouts on the lower-left, about 4 cm across | 40
ITEM 6 | Single wilted green leaf piece with darker edges and a slightly glossy, limp texture, lying separately on the lower-right of the plate, about 4 cm across | 8
ITEM 7 | Small scattered green herb flecks and minced bits, dispersed over the potatoes, light and dry-looking | 2
